text: Police Inspector Ochumelov. <break time="0.8s" /> Was walking across the market square. <break time="0.8s" /> In a new overcoat. <break time="0.8s" /> Carrying a small bundle under his arm. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind him walked. <break time="0.8s" /> A red haired policeman named Yeldyrin. <break time="0.8s" /> Holding a sieve full of gooseberries. <break time="0.8s" /> Taken away from someone. <break time="0.8s" /> All around them was silence. <break time="0.8s" /> And there was not a single person. <break time="0.8s" /> In the square. <break time="0.8s" /> The open doors of the shops and taverns. <break time="0.8s" /> Looked out on the world sadly. <break time="0.8s" /> Like hungry mouths. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly Ochumelov heard a man shouting. <break time="0.8s" /> So you bite, do you. <break time="0.8s" /> You terrible beast. <break time="0.8s" /> Do not let it go, lads. <break time="0.8s" /> A small dog came running. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of Pichugins woodyard on three legs. <break time="0.8s" /> Whining loudly as it ran. <break time="0.8s" /> A man in a starched shirt. <break time="0.8s" /> Chased after it. <break time="0.8s" /> And throwing himself forward. <break time="0.8s" /> He fell to the ground. <break time="0.8s" /> And grabbed its back legs. <break time="0.8s" /> Sleepy faces looked out from the shops. <break time="0.8s" /> And soon a crowd gathered. <break time="0.8s" /> Around the woodyard. <break time="0.8s" /> As if it had sprung out of the ground. <break time="0.8s" /> It looks like a disturbance, sir. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the policeman. <break time="0.8s" /> And Ochumelov turned. <break time="0.8s" /> And marched toward the crowd. <break time="0.8s" /> At the gate stood the man. <break time="0.8s" /> Holding up his bleeding finger. <break time="0.8s" /> Which looked like a flag of victory.
